info.description: Seek: student homes, tenancies, rent, bills, inbox and AI search.

name.description: The member's name, once they have a Seek account.

source.description: Where the item came from. Student status can come from a confirmed university email; "request" means Seek emailed a guarantor or referee and is waiting on their reply (status PENDING).

requestedAt.description: When Seek emailed the guarantor or referee (source "request" only).

reason.description: Status REJECTED only: what to fix, from the automatic review. Only for the owner or a viewer with an active share.

active.description: Not revoked and not yet expired.

url.description: Signed link to open the file, valid 60 seconds. Null if the file has no private key.

status.description: Only PENDING is accepted: it runs the automatic check again.

key.description: Object key returned by /upload/presign. Must have been issued to the calling account.

reason.description: Why the provider cannot be connected on this server.

Energy fair-use allowance for the household, in pence per month. null removes it.

link.description: seek-web path to open, e.g. /student/home/rent. Same route as `target`.

target.description:
Typed destination: a logical `screen` plus the `id` it is about. Clients route on `screen`;
`link` is the seek-web path and `mobile` the seek-mobile path (students only).

| kind | student screen → web / mobile | landlord screen → web |
|---|---|---|
| PAYMENTS | rent → /student/home/rent / /(app)/(tabs)/rent | landlord-rent → /rent |
| COMPLIANCE | deposit → /student/home/deposit / /(app)/deposit | dashboard → /dashboard |
| TENANCY | home → /student/home / /(app)/(tabs)/my-home | contracts → /contracts |
| CONTRACTS | contract → /student/home / /(app)/contract | contracts → /contracts |
| REPAIRS | repairs → /student/home / /(app)/repairs | dashboard → /dashboard |
| APPLICATION | applications → /student/home / /(app)/(tabs)/applied | application → /application?listing=<listing>&id=<id> (or /applicants) |
